Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: Under clear daylight conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the right lane of a two-way, two-lane local roadway with parked vehicles lining both sides of the street. A red pickup truck equipped with a black roll bar and various decals on its rear was traveling directly ahead at a slow and steady speed. Utility poles, trees, and low-rise buildings bordered the roadway, with a white wall visible on the left and residential homes on the right. The ego vehicle came to a stop behind the red pickup truck. After moving forward a short distance, the red pickup abruptly applied its brakes and came to a sudden stop. The ego vehicle began to move forward but immediately applied emergency braking, narrowly avoiding a rear-end collision with the pickup. The red pickup then resumed forward travel, and the ego vehicle followed at a safe distance within the same lane. As both vehicles approached an intersection ahead, the red pickup gradually decelerated and came to a stop. The ego vehicle also stopped behind it, maintaining its lane position.

Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: Under cloudy daytime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling on an exit ramp of a multi-lane highway, with overhead signage indicating upcoming exit information. The ego vehicle was initially following a white sedan traveling ahead in the same direction. The ego vehicle then changed lanes to the right lane, overtook the white sedan on its right side, and continued traveling forward, approaching a white New York City Police Department (NYPD) van traveling in the same direction. The ego vehicle first positioned itself directly behind the van, and subsequently attempted to change lanes to the right in order to overtake the van on its right side. During this overtaking maneuver, the van suddenly drifted to the right and encroached into the ego vehicle's lane, resulting in a near-collision. In response, the ego vehicle decelerated and steered slightly to the right to avoid the collision. After the conflict was avoided, the ego vehicle resumed motion, successfully passed the van, and continued traveling forward, increasing distance from the van.

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: No collision

One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: Under clear, unlit nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling on a two-way, two-lane rural roadway divided by double yellow centerlines. Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: Under clear daylight conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane highway in a rural area. Trees lined both sides of the roadway, with dry grass and shrubs present along the shoulders, and distant mountains were faintly visible under a clear blue sky. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight at a steady speed. As the ego vehicle continued forward, a white SUV traveling ahead and to the right in the right lane began making a left turn, entering the ego vehicle's path of travel. Shortly thereafter, the front of the ego vehicle collided with the left side of the white SUV. The impact caused the camera view to shift, and glass fragments and debris scattered through the scene. Liquid also appeared on the front windshield. After the collision, the ego vehicle continued traveling straight ahead.

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: Under clear daylight conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the center lane of a divided, two-way, multi-lane highway on a large suspension bridge. The roadway had multiple lanes separated by white dashed lane markings, with a concrete barrier along the left side. The bridge crossed over a body of water, with a tree-lined shoreline visible on the right and city buildings visible on the left. The ego vehicle was following the flow of traffic and proceeding forward steadily. A black SUV was traveling ahead of the ego vehicle in the same lane at a similar speed. As the ego vehicle approached a gantry equipped with overhead electronic signs, the black SUV directly ahead gradually slowed down. The ego vehicle continued straight and closed the distance to the black SUV, and the front of the ego vehicle subsequently collided with the rear of the black SUV. The impact caused the black SUV to travel toward the left front, after which the front of the black SUV collided with the concrete barrier on the left side and came to a stop. Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: Under clear daylight conditions, the ego vehicle was stationary in the center lane of a multi-lane highway approaching a signal-controlled intersection beneath an overpass. The roadway was marked with multiple lanes separated by solid white lane lines. The traffic signal ahead displayed a red indication, and vehicles were stopped in place. Directly ahead of the ego vehicle was a dark gray pickup truck. To the left of the ego vehicle, a silver hatchback was positioned at an angle with its rear facing toward the ego vehicle. In front of the silver hatchback was a black SUV, followed by a white SUV farther ahead. In the adjacent right lane ahead of the ego vehicle, a white pickup truck was observed making a right turn into the intersection. Overhead green guide signs displayed directions for "I-395" and "I-66." On the right side of the roadway, a metal guardrail separated the travel lanes from a tree-lined vegetated area. Subsequently, a beige open-top dump truck bearing the message "Frequent Work Vehicle Turns" on its side traveled forward from behind on the right side and passed the ego vehicle. At approximately the same time, the silver hatchback to the left began reversing slowly toward the ego vehicle. The silver hatchback continued backing up until the rear of the hatchback struck the left side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a low-speed side-impact collision. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: Under cloudy daylight conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the leftmost lane of a multilane highway. A grassy embankment bordered the left side of the roadway, while a tree-covered grassy embankment was present on the right. A large black semi-trailer truck was traveling directly ahead in the same lane, carrying heavy machinery stacked well above the top of the cab and secured by visible support structures. Several other vehicles were traveling in the adjacent lane to the right. As traffic approached a series of overpasses, the semi-trailer truck passed beneath the first bridge without incident. While traveling under the second bridge, the top of the elevated cargo contacted the underside of the bridge, producing visible scraping. The cargo shifted slightly, and debris fell from the load. The truck continued forward, and as it approached the third bridge, the cargo struck the bridge structure again with greater force. This impact caused the upper portion of the load to tilt and nearly separate from the trailer, while the supporting structures showed clear signs of stress and displacement. The truck continued beneath the bridge, and although the cargo did not completely detach, it was visibly damaged. Throughout the incident, the ego vehicle continued straight in the leftmost lane and slightly reduced its speed, while the other vehicles in the adjacent lane maintained their paths and continued traveling.

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: Under cloudy daylight conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the center lane of a divided, two-way, multilane highway with a concrete median barrier separating opposing traffic. A red sedan was traveling ahead and to the left of the ego vehicle, while a red hatchback was traveling in the adjacent lane to the right. Several other vehicles were present farther ahead and in the right-side lanes. The roadway was elevated, and mountains were visible in the distance. As the ego vehicle continued straight within its lane, the red sedan ahead and to the left suddenly lost control and began swerving from side to side before colliding with the concrete median barrier. The impact caused the vehicle to roll onto its side and tumble multiple times along the roadway. Vehicle debris was scattered across the pavement, while the ego vehicle gradually decelerated as it approached the crashed vehicle.

Use clear past tense and professional traffic-report language. Output only the narrative paragraph, with no labels, no bullet points, and no extra text. One-shot example: Under clear, illuminated nighttime conditions, the ego vehicle was traveling in the left lane of a two-way, multi-lane urban roadway divided by a landscaped median. The roadway surface was illuminated by streetlights and vehicle headlights. High-rise buildings lined both sides of the street, and vehicles were parked along the curb lanes. The ego vehicle was proceeding straight behind a black SUV in the same lane. The ego vehicle continued straight through two consecutive four-leg intersections while following the black SUV. Upon entering a third four-leg intersection, the black SUV proceeded straight through the intersection and continued into the opposing roadway. At that point, the ego vehicle initiated a right turn to enter the adjacent roadway on the right. During the right-turn maneuver, a white sedan approached from the ego vehicle's right rear in the adjacent right lane. The white sedan overtook the ego vehicle on the right and continued forward alongside it. As the vehicles converged, the left side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a same-direction sideswipe collision. Following the impact, the ego vehicle immediately came to a stop at or near the intersection. The white sedan continued forward a short distance and then also came to a stop. The driver of the white sedan exited the vehicle and used a mobile phone to record or photograph the ego vehicle. Shortly thereafter, the ego vehicle restarted and completed the right turn at a slow speed.
answer: Under clear dusk conditions with good visibility, the ego vehicle was stationary in a parking lot adjacent to a large commercial building, with a prominent "C" sign visible on the left side of the structure. The sky displayed a gradient from pale yellow near the horizon to dim blue overhead. The parking lot was fully occupied with various vehicles, including sedans, SUVs, and pickup trucks, arranged in marked spaces separated by yellow lines. A tall light pole was visible on the left side of the scene, and a tree with yellow autumn foliage stood on the right. Throughout the entire recording, the ego vehicle remained stationary. While the ego vehicle was parked, a white sedan approached from the left side of the lot, then executed a right turn into a parking space on the right side of the ego vehicle. The white sedan subsequently performed multiple reversing maneuvers, backing out and re-entering the space. During these maneuvers, the right side of the white sedan made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a sideswipe collision that caused the ego vehicle to shake. The white sedan continued maneuvering back and forth, and after pulling out of the space, the right side of the white sedan again made contact with the right side of the ego vehicle, resulting in a second sideswipe collision. Following the second impact, the white sedan reversed and came to a position diagonally in front of the ego vehicle, then proceeded to move laterally from right to left across the front of the ego vehicle. The ego vehicle remained stationary throughout the entire incident.
